summary: Implemented all 6 phases of the /orchestrate --dry-run admission report plan. Added DRY_RUN_FLAG to parse-command-args.sh; created the shared read-only orchestrate-triage-classify.sh classifier (engine=single|mt, both precedence tables transcribed, the Stage 4/Stage MT-4 divergence asserted by test); created orchestrate-dry-run-report.sh composing batch-admit + task-lock check + predecessor scan + triage into a six-section report; wired --dry-run into commands/orchestrate.md STAGE 0 as a short-circuit with an explicit prohibition block; wired Stage MT-4 in skill-orchestrate/SKILL.md to call the shared classifier (with a documented degradation fallback to the retained grouping table) and cross-referenced the single-task partial handler. Both new scripts registered in manifest.json. Two fixture test suites (6 + 14 assertions) pass 100% using the scratch-deploy-tree pattern, asserting read-only behavior, exact table-row reproduction, the engine divergence, lock nuances (self-held vs foreign vs stale), MAX_TASKS trim reporting, and Kahn-ordering wave assignment.
